suggestions.title: Scope observed quota failures by project in routing
suggestions.rationale: The Quota And Routing UAT plan calls for per-project observed quota failure coverage. SqliteQuotaFailureStore records project_id, but AgentClassRouter only queries GetMostRecentAsync by agent and model, so a failure observed for project-a blocks project-b for the same agent/model. Production code changes are out of scope for this UAT coverage work item, so the intended isolation test is present but skipped.
